title: Check version for the new fields in the Prevalidation API

timeline.message: version guards for new fields in the Prevalidation API
timeline.author: Pooya Salehi

timeline.body:
Check version when (de)serializing the new fields in the Prevalidation request/response

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/91965

Also I am not enirely sure, but I think I do not need to consider the node versions when fanning out the `TransportPrevalidateShardPathAction` requests, since an 8.6 node receiving this request from an 8.7 master, would just fail the request which would end up as `unable_to_verify_red_shards` in the final response.

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/6871283fd173efcbf716f39dd16ca3fb5edca5ac/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/admin/cluster/node/shutdown/TransportPrevalidateNodeRemovalAction.java#L211-L233

@elasticmachine run elasticsearch-ci/packaging-tests-windows-sample 
I think this is a known CI issue:
```
> Premature end of Content-Length delimited message body (expected: 340,418,397; received: 247,462,048)
```

> I think I do not need to consider the node versions when fanning out the `TransportPrevalidateShardPathAction` requests.

This makes sense to me. Ideally we'd have a test for it though, perhaps we can add one as a follow-up? I can see two paths for it: add a red shard yml test case (if we can), which will then make the call in mixed cluster tests. Or add a dedicated mixed cluster test for this.
Can we add a comment that `reason` is only nullable for bwc, i.e., for a fully upgraded cluster, we expect non-null?

timeline.author: Pooya Salehi

timeline.body: Thanks Henning! I'll add the test in a follow-up. I have to look into how can I have the red-shard-setup in a yaml test (probably easier as a "normal" IT).
